```{r}
setwd("/scratch/cji4/STAT778_Project")
# Generate
source("code/scripts/03_gen_misspec.R")
# Smoke-test the 2x2 fit with 2 replicates only, before committing to 30
source("code/R/logging.R"); source("code/R/io.R"); source("code/R/fit_core.R")
scenario <- load_scenario("MISSPEC", "pois_pilot")
smoke <- fit_scenario(scenario, replicates = 1:2,
                     fit_marginal_spec = list(family = "negbin"))
smoke$misspecified  # should be TRUE
smoke$results
```
